arguments.heading: What happened at the argument

Justice Scalia questioned whether leaving the subsidiary issue open resolves the case.

paragraphs: This case tests the limits of state court power over foreign corporations. the sides that brought the case want the North Carolina court to drop the case. the opposing sides want the court to keep the case and decide the claims.
